category: hosted front end for a debrid account (Android TV, Fire TV, mobile) with a web account portal

free_tier.stated: 'Free - The essentials, done well: Beautiful, snappy interface / Kids profile / JustWatch integration / Frequent updates'. Pro adds '3-day free trial' and the playback features.
free_tier.notes: The site does not print a Pro price; it defers to an in-app purchase on Google Play. A forum post put it at '£10 a year' (reported, December 2024).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a player, not a store

retention.stated: not applicable: the library is the client's debrid account

egress.terms: Not metered by the app. Playback pulls from the debrid provider, so the provider's caps apply; Debrid Stream publishes no traffic figure of its own.

interface_detail: The site's 'Configure your account' button points at account.debridstream.com, which is where a debrid key is entered (third-party write-ups describe that portal and the Google TV app as the two ways to paste a key into a TV). No browser playback is advertised: the screens are Android TV, Fire TV and mobile.
tooling: an installable app per platform plus the web portal. The portal exists precisely so a TV remote never has to type a 40-character key.
chaining: The alternative front end when the client wants a television-shaped app rather than a Stremio addon list: it holds the debrid key centrally and adds Trakt scrobbling and OpenSubtitles on the paid tier.

limits.value: playback features sit behind the Pro unlock: auto-play, link filtering, custom catalog, Trakt, OpenSubtitles and third-party addons are all Pro-only

limits_note: The free tier is a browsing shell: it can list and play, but the automated-source-selection and addon ecosystem that make a debrid front end usable are paywalled. The app also cannot be driven from a desktop browser.
binding_note: No byte cap is published, so the first thing that stops a working pipeline is the Pro paywall, which removes auto-play, filtering and addon support from the free tier.

identity_cost.detail: Google Play account for the app and a paid unlock for Pro, on top of a debrid subscription. The app itself installs free.

reliability_note: Store-distributed app: the free tier's feature set can change with a Play Store update, and reports of the price come from forum posts rather than the vendor.
confidence_note: The landing page was read today and both tiers are quoted. Not measured: installation, playback, and the actual Pro price, which is only visible inside Google Play. That the portal is the key-entry path is inferred from the button label plus third-party posts, not from the portal itself.

evidence.proved: the platform list (Android TV, Fire TV, Mobile), the Free/Pro split and the exact Pro feature list, plus 'Configure your account' at account.debridstream.com
third-party (December 2024): 'It's £10 a year' - the only published price found; reported, not confirmed by the vendor
third-party: the key is pasted through the web portal or the Google TV app, which confirms the portal is the configuration path

notes: Included because it is the one front end found that is neither an addon nor a browser tab: a hosted account service plus native TV apps. Its weakness for a user is the same as every app: it needs a device, and the free tier is the shell rather than the engine.
